Theoretical probabilities and quantiles are always calculated on full support. view_range <- function(s, lower = .005, upper = .995) { if (identical(s$label, "t")) return(c(-5, 5)) # A very large log-scale SD produces a long tail that can conceal the # visible body of the density. Focus the display on the main density. if (identical(s$label, "Log-normal")) { median_x <- s$quant(.5) sdlog <- log(s$quant(.841344746) / median_x) mode_x <- median_x * exp(-sdlog^2) return(c(0, min(s$quant(.995), 100 * mode_x))) } q <- suppressWarnings(s$quant(c(lower, upper))) if (any(!is.finite(q)) || diff(q) <= 0) q <- c(-4, 4) if (s$discrete) c(floor(q[1]), ceiling(q[2])) else q } # Density of chi-squared(1) is unbounded at zero; cap the display height # without altering the distribution or its probability calculations. density_plot_limit <- function(s, x, y) { if (identical(s$label, "Chi-squared") && is.finite(s$var) && s$mean < 2) return(2) valid <- y[is.finite(y)] if (!length(valid)) return(1) max(valid) * 1.14 } # Preserve a useful reference scale while parameters change. Expand the window # only when the current distribution would otherwise be substantially clipped. # Reset axes explicitly to fit the current distribution again. axis_limits <- function(s, baseline = NULL, marks = numeric(0), cdf = FALSE) { current <- view_range(s) if (is.null(baseline)) baseline <- current if (identical(s$label, "t")) { lim <- c(-5, 5) } else { lim <- baseline span <- diff(lim) if (!is.finite(span) || span <= 0) span <- 1 # Only enlarge when the central 99% is not already visible. if (current[1] < lim[1]) lim[1] <- current[1] - .06 * span if (current[2] > lim[2]) lim[2] <- current[2] + .06 * span visible_marks <- marks[is.finite(marks)] if (length(visible_marks)) { if (min(visible_marks) < lim[1]) lim[1] <- min(visible_marks) - .06 * span if (max(visible_marks) > lim[2]) lim[2] <- max(visible_marks) + .06 * span } } if (diff(lim) <= 0) lim <- lim + c(-1, 1) xx <- seq(lim[1], lim[2], length.out = 1200) if (identical(s$label, "Chi-squared")) xx <- pmax(xx, 1e-3) yy <- s$dens(xx) peak <- density_plot_limit(s, xx, yy) base_peak <- if (is.null(attr(baseline, "peak"))) peak else attr(baseline, "peak") # Avoid y-axis shrinkage; still allow expansion when a curve becomes taller. ymax <- if (cdf) 1.02 else max(peak, base_peak) list(x = lim, y = c(0, ymax)) } plot_density <- function(s, mode = "none", a = 0, b = 1, p = .975, main = "Probability density", cdf = FALSE, limits = NULL) { if (mode == "quantile") a <- s$quant(p) if (mode == "between" && b < a) { tmp <- a; a <- b; b <- tmp } marks <- if (mode == "between") c(a,b) else if (mode != "none") a else numeric(0) if (is.null(limits)) limits <- axis_limits(s, marks=marks, cdf=cdf) lim <- limits$x x <- seq(lim[1], lim[2], length.out = 850) if (identical(s$label, "Chi-squared")) x <- pmax(x, 1e-3) y <- if (cdf) s$cdf(x) else s$dens(x) y[!is.finite(y)] <- NA_real_ plot(x, y, type = "n", xlab = "Value", ylab = if (cdf) "Cumulative probability" else "Density", main = main, las = 1, xlim = lim, ylim = limits$y) if (!cdf && mode != "none") { sel <- switch(mode, left = x <= a, right = x >= a, between = x >= a & x <= b, quantile = x <= a, rep(FALSE,length(x))) if (any(sel)) polygon(c(x[sel][1], x[sel], tail(x[sel],1)), c(0, y[sel], 0), col = adjustcolor(s$fill, alpha.f=.63), border=NA) } lines(x, y, col = s$col, lwd = 3) for (v in marks) if (is.finite(v) && v >= lim[1] && v <= lim[2]) { abline(v = v, col = PAL$coral, lty = 2, lwd = 1.7) if (cdf) points(v, s$cdf(v), pch=21, bg=PAL$lightcoral, col=PAL$coral, cex=1.5) } if (identical(s$label, "Chi-squared") && !cdf && s$mean == 1) mtext("Density near zero is clipped for readability", side=3, line=0.15, cex=.7, col=PAL$teal) if (identical(s$label, "Log-normal") && !cdf && lim[2] < s$quant(.995) * .99) mtext("Long right tail extends beyond this view", side=3, line=0.15, cex=.7, col=PAL$teal) if (identical(s$label, "t") && any(marks < lim[1] | marks > lim[2])) mtext("Selected cutoff is outside the displayed range", side=3, line=0.15, cex=.7, col=PAL$teal) } # Discrete exact probability and continuity-corrected (or uncorrected) normal approximation. approx_probability <- function(dist, trials, prob, lambda, mode, a, b, ppois(k, lambda) offset <- if (cc) .5 else 0 k <- floor(a); h <- floor(b) if (mode == "left") { exact <- cdf(k); approx <- pnorm(k+offset, mean, sd) bounds <- c(-Inf,k+offset) } else if (mode == "right") { exact <- 1-cdf(k); approx <- 1-pnorm(k+offset, mean, sd) bounds <- c(k+offset,Inf) } else { lo <- min(k,h); hi <- max(k,h) exact <- cdf(hi)-cdf(lo-1) bounds <- c(lo-offset,hi+offset) approx <- pnorm(bounds[2],mean,sd)-pnorm(bounds[1],mean,sd) } list(exact=exact, approx=approx, mean=mean, sd=sd, bounds=bounds) } # Render MathJax in control labels; native dropdown options use Unicode.
